scope: TRAIN_CLASSIFIER background jobs and learning cycle state

observed_behavior: claim_job selects only QUEUED jobs and sets RUNNING without a lease or stale-job recovery
complete_job marks the job COMPLETED before update_learning_cycle moves the cycle from TRAINING to EVALUATE
fail_job marks the job FAILED and update_learning_cycle moves the cycle to EVALUATE without a retry transition
failure_windows: worker exits while a job is RUNNING and no worker claims it again
worker exits after job completion but before the learning cycle transition
a retry is requested after a partial offline training attempt

data_ml_boundary.responsibility: Validate or resume immutable offline files for the same cycle without replacing existing evidence

required_integration.job_recovery: Requeue stale RUNNING jobs only after an expired lease, with an attempt or fencing token that prevents an old worker from publishing a late result.
required_integration.completion_recovery: Commit job completion and the learning cycle transition atomically, or reconcile COMPLETED jobs whose cycle remains TRAINING from the persisted result.
required_integration.failed_attempts: Define an explicit authorized retry transition for FAILED jobs and cycles; preserve previous error and attempt history.
required_integration.privacy: Persist only safe error codes and aggregate evidence; never log feedback text, personal identifiers or attachments.

acceptance_evidence: a worker terminated while RUNNING is safely reclaimed once its lease expires
a late worker with an obsolete fencing token cannot complete or overwrite a newer attempt
a worker terminated between job completion and cycle transition is reconciled to one consistent state
a failed attempt can be retried without overwriting immutable offline artifacts or duplicating model and dataset registrations
retry errors and logs contain no feedback text or personal fields
